articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.titleKo: Claude의 텍스트 워터마킹 작동 방식
articles.summary:
In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.

articles.title: Agentic AI infrastructure shifts enterprise focus from model choice to platform control
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 인프라는 기업의 초점을 모델 선택에서 플랫폼 제어로 전환함
articles.summary:
The turning point comes when companies begin treating AI not as a pilot project but as an operating model with enterprise-scale consequences, according to Joe Fernandes , vice president and general manager of the Artificial Intelligence Business Unit at Red Hat Inc.
That shift is pushing organizations to rethink how much they should rely on public cloud AI services alone, especially as agentic systems move from simple assistants into persistent enterprise applications that act across business systems.
“I think that platform teams are more important than ever because this is the next layer of the enterprise platform, and agents are the next evolution of enterprise applications,” Fernandes said.
